content: Tak dawk hoi ka tâcawt e hno kathounghoehe
BAWIPA ni Mosi hoi Aron koe bout a dei pouh e teh,
Nangmouh roi ni Isarel miphunnaw koe na dei pouh hane teh, tongpa tie pueng atak dawk lacip tâcawt pawiteh, hote lacip teh thoung hoeh.
Pou a tâco nakunghai thoseh, avaivai a tâco nakunghai thoseh, hote tami teh thoung hoeh.
A inae, a tahungnae naw pueng hai thoung hoeh.
Ahnie ikhun kâbet e tami, a tahungnae dawk ka tahung e tami teh,
Ahnie tak kâbet e tami hoi,
Tamtui kâbet e tami teh amae e khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han.
Hote tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
A kâcuinae rangdoun hai thoung hoeh.
Hote tami e rahim kaawm e hno kâbet e tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh. Hote hno buetbuet touh ka sin e tami teh amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Lacip ka tâcawt e tami ni a kut pâsu laipalah alouke tami a kut hoi tek pawiteh, hote tami teh a khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Lacip ka tâcawt e tami ni a kâbet e talai hlaam rek hem han. Thingtongben teh tui hoi pâsu han.
Lacip ka tâcawt e tami a patawnae a dam torei teh, a damnae hnin hoi a kamtawng vaiteh, hnin sari touh aloum hnukkhu, amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh, tui kalawng a kamhluk vaiteh a kamthoung han.
Ataroe hnin vah, bakhu kahni touh thoseh, âbakhu kahni touh thoseh buetbuet touh Cathut hmalah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a thokhai vaiteh vaihma koe a poe han.
Vaihma ni yon thueng nahanelah buet touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanelah buet touh a thueng vaiteh lacip ka tâcawt e tami hanelah BAWIPA hmalah yonthanae a sak pouh han.
Tongpa ni a yangtui tâcawt pawiteh tui a kamhluk han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
A yangtui kâbet e pueng teh tui hoi pâsu han. Ama hai tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Tongpa ni napui hoi ip roi pawiteh tui a kamhluk roi han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Napui ni kampheng pawiteh hnin sari touh thung thoung hoeh. Ahni kâbet e tami hai tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
A kampheng lahun nah a inae hoi a tahungnae naw pueng hai thoung hoeh.
Ahnie a inae hoi a tahungnae ka kâbet e tami teh amae khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han.
Hote tami teh tangmin totouh kathounghoehe lah ao.
A inae ikhun dawk thoseh, a tahungnae dawk thoseh, a pacâ e thi ka kâbet e tami teh tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Ka kampheng e napui hoi ka ip e tami teh hnin sari touh thung thoung hoeh. A inae pueng haiyah thoung hoeh.
A kamphengnae hnin akuep hnukkhu, a thi khap hoeh rah pawiteh, a thikhap hoehroukrak, kamphengnae tueng patetlah thoung hoeh.
A thikui e a dam hoehroukrak ahnie a inae hoi a tahungnae teh a kamphengnae patetlah thoung hoeh.
Hote hnonaw ka kâbet e tami hai a thounghoeh dawkvah amae e khohna a pâsu vaiteh tui a kamhluk han. Tangmin totouh thoung hoeh.
Hote napui teh thikui e a khap hnukkhu, hnin sari touh loum pawiteh a thoung han.
Ataroe hnin vah, bakhu kahni touh thoseh, âbakhu kahni touh thoseh, buetbuet touh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe, vaihma koevah a thokhai han.
Vaihma ni yon thueng nahanelah buet touh, hmaisawi thueng nahanelah buet touh a thueng vaiteh, kampheng nah kathounghoehe napui hanelah BAWIPA hmalah yonthanae a sak pouh han.
Hottelah, Isarel miphunnaw ni ahnimouh koe kaawm e Kaie lukkareiim a khin sak awh teh, a thounghoehnae dawk a due awh hoeh nahanlah a kamthoung awh han.
Hete phung teh tak dawk hoi lacip ka tâcawt e, a yangtui ka tâcawt ni teh kakhin e tami, ka kampheng e napui,
Napui tongpa o inae dawk tarawi hane kawi phung doeh atipouh.
